name: ES Auction Polarity Transfer v1
instrument: ES continuous front-month signal with one MES execution unit
hypothesis: When morning accepted value and lunch accepted value occupy opposite sides of the cash open, the anchor ordering records a true participant-group polarity reversal. If lunch's terminal price agrees with its center, the lunch group has taken control and the cash-open boundary should separate its inventory from the abandoned morning state.

signal.auction_center: volume-weighted mean of one-minute typical price (high + low + close) / 3
signal.polarity_transfer: morning center and lunch center are strictly on opposite sides of the cash open
signal.long_signal: polarity transfer holds, lunch center is above cash open, and 13:29 close is above cash open
signal.short_signal: polarity transfer holds, lunch center is below cash open, and 13:29 close is below cash open
signal.zero_rule: no trade if either center touches the cash open or lunch terminal price does not confirm lunch polarity

execution.entry: 13:30 open plus one adverse ES tick
execution.long_stop_trigger: one ES tick below the cash open
execution.short_stop_trigger: one ES tick above the cash open
execution.stop_fill: the trigger price unless the stop bar opens beyond it, then the worse bar open plus one adverse tick
execution.geometry_rule: skip if the stop is not adverse to entry
execution.same_bar_rule: if the 13:30 entry bar touches the stop trigger, assume the stop fills
execution.survivor_exit: 15:55 open plus one adverse ES tick
execution.position_limit: one MES and at most one trade per RTH session

lesson: Reordering morning and lunch value centers across the cash open was not evidence that lunch controlled the close. The exact rule lost in every year and both directions.
holdout_policy: 2024-2025 was not evaluated because the unchanged rule failed its development gates.
prohibited_posthoc_changes: changing the cash-open anchor or either auction boundary
trading the morning rather than lunch polarity
adding center-distance, volume, volatility, side, weekday, or regime filters
using a midpoint or auction center as the stop after observing results
changing the entry or exit clock
